items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Monsieur Levy was the... Monsieur Levy booked it. Jacob, he was. The impresario.

ctx.x: Can you remember....you were saying /a call to come back to Europe and...I think there was something called Jeunesse Musical...
Jeunesse Musical du France. Monsieur Levy was the...

Monsieur Levy booked it. Jacob, he was. The impresario. Now the Jeunesse Musical d.u France was an organization just like some of the organizations; it was underwritten by the French government. One of the things about most of those foreign countries, though, Dan, is that they put in money into the arts. Did you know that? Most of them do. And I can't say...well, perhaps they'd do it in America; and then again, maybe I have a right to have this beef, that if they're going to send opera and opera singers to Japan,…
